purpose: The element sequence of Facturae's InvoiceTotals block and each element's own computation annotation, bundled because no Facturae element equals this codebase's invoice total: InvoiceTotal is stated net of withheld tax and excludes reimbursable expenses, so the total has to be derived from documented parts rather than read.

provenance.payload_encoding: utf-8 with BOM, as declared by the payload and verified by codepoint
provenance.extracted: The InvoiceTotalsType element sequence and its xs:documentation annotations, verbatim in both published languages. The schema itself is not redistributed.

elements.name: TotalGrossAmount
documentation: (TGA) Total sum of the gross amounts of the invoice items. Up to eight decimal points.
Total Importe Bruto. Suma total de importes brutos de los detalles de la factura. Hasta ocho decimales.

elements.name: GeneralDiscounts
documentation: Discounts on the Total Gross Amount. There will be as many blocks of fields GeneralDiscounts as there are different discount types applied to the same invoice.
Descuentos sobre el Total Importe Bruto. Habrá tantos bloques de campos GeneralDiscounts como clases de descuentos diferentes se apliquen a nivel de factura.

elements.name: GeneralSurcharges
documentation: Charges on the Total Gross Amount. There will be as many blocks of fields GeneralSurcharges as types of charges/surcharges are applied to the invoice.
Cargos sobre el Total Importe Bruto. Habrá tantos bloques de campos GeneralSurcharges como clases de cargos/recargos se apliquen, a nivel de factura.

elements.name: TotalGeneralDiscounts
documentation: Sum of different fields GeneralDiscounts. Up to eight decimal points.
Total general de descuentos. Sumatorio de los importes de los diferentes campos GeneralDiscounts. Hasta ocho decimales.

elements.name: TotalGeneralSurcharges
documentation: Sum of different fields GeneralSurcharges. Up to eight decimal points.
Total general de cargos. Sumatorio de los importes de los diferentes campos GeneralSurcharges. Hasta ocho decimales

elements.name: TotalGrossAmountBeforeTaxes
documentation: Result: TotalGrossAmount - TotalGeneralDiscounts + TotalGeneralSurcharges. Up to eight decimal points.
Total importe bruto antes de impuestos. Resultado de: TotalGrossAmount - TotalGeneralDiscounts + TotalGeneralSurcharges. Hasta ocho decimales.

elements.name: TotalTaxOutputs
documentation: Sum of different fields Tax Amounts + Total Equivalence Surcharges. Up to eight decimal points.
Total impuestos repercutidos. Sumatorio de todas Cuotas y Recargos de Equivalencia. Hasta ocho decimales.

elements.name: TotalTaxesWithheld
documentation: Sum of different fields TaxAmount. Up to eight decimal points.
Total impuestos retenidos. Hasta ocho decimales.

elements.name: InvoiceTotal
documentation: Result: TotalGrossAmountBeforeTaxes + TotalTaxOutputs - TotalTaxesWithheld. Up to eight decimal points.
Total factura. Resultado de: TotalGrossAmountBeforeTaxes + TotalTaxOutputs - TotalTaxesWithheld. Hasta ocho decimales.

elements.name: Subsidies
documentation: Subsidies, grants or aids for acquisition of certain goods granted by General government.

Subvenciones por adquisición de determinados bienes. Habrá tantos bloques de campos Subsidies como subvenciones se apliquen. En el caso de que la subvención se aplique solo a parte de las operaciones facturadas, en el subelemento SubsidyDescription se especificará también a qué operación corresponde.

elements.name: PaymentsOnAccount
documentation: Payments made on account of the Invoices Total. There will be as many blocks PaymentsOnAccount as types of payments on account applied to the invoice.
Anticipos. Pagos anticipados sobre el Total Facturas. Habrá tantos bloques PaymentsOnAccount como clases de anticipos se apliquen a nivel factura.

elements.name: ReimbursableExpenses
documentation: Those included in the invoice.
Suplidos incorporados en la factura.

elements.name: TotalFinancialExpenses
documentation: Always to two decimal points.
Total de gastos financieros. Siempre con dos decimales.

elements.name: TotalOutstandingAmount
documentation: Result: InvoiceTotal - (SubsidyAmount + TotalPaymentsOnAccount). Up to eight decimal points.
Total a pagar. Resultado de: InvoiceTotal - (Total subvenciones + TotalPaymentsOnAccount). En Total subvenciones se suman las cantidades especificadas en los bloques Subsidies. Hasta ocho decimales.

elements.name: TotalPaymentsOnAccount
documentation: Sum of the fields PaymentOnAccountAmount. Up to eight decimal points.
Total de anticipos. Sumatorio de los campos PaymentOnAccountAmount. Hasta ocho decimales.

elements.name: AmountsWithheld
documentation: Amounts withheld by the payer subject to the normal fulfilment of the transaction.
Cantidades que retiene el pagador hasta el buen fin de la operación.

elements.name: TotalExecutableAmount
documentation: Result: TotalOutstandingAmount - WithholdingAmount - PaymentInKindAmount + Reimbursable expenses + Financial expenses. Up to eight points

Total a ejecutar. Resultado de: TotalOutstandingAmount - WithholdingAmount - PaymentInKindAmount + TotalReimbursableExpenses + TotalFinancialExpenses. En Total de Cantidades retenidas se sumaran las cantidades especificadas en los bloques AmountsWithheld. Hasta ocho decimales.

elements.name: TotalReimbursableExpenses
documentation: Up to eight decimal points.
Total de suplidos. Hasta ocho decimales.

elements.name: PaymentInKind
documentation: Payment in kind.
Pagos en especie.
